description: CSINodeDriverRegistration holds the node ID of a CSI driver whose topology and volume attachment limit are reported by the CSI controller.

name.description: name is the name of the CSI driver. This MUST be the same name returned by the CSI GetPluginInfo() call for that driver. This field is required.

nodeID.description: nodeID is the ID of the node from the driver's point of view, as returned by the driver's NodeGetInfo call. This field is required.
